'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Siege of Gaza City]]
****The [[Israel Defense Forces]] says that it has established full "operational control" of the [[Shuja'iyya]] neighborhood in [[Gaza City]], which has been the scene of intense clashes between [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli troops]] and [[Hamas]] in recent weeks. *[[Yemeni Crisis (2011–present)|Yemeni Crisis]]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***At least 10 more nations, including [[Australia]] and [[Greece]], join the [[United States]]-led [[Operation Prosperity Guardian]] [[task force]] to counter [[Houthi movement|Houthi]] attacks in the [[Red Sea]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/more-than-20-countries-now-part-us-led-red-sea-coalition-pentagon-2023-12-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
**Four [[Indian Army|Indian soldiers]] are killed and three others are injured after gunmen opened fire against two army vehicles in [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], [[India]]. [https://apnews.com/article/kashmir-india-pakistan-rebels-army-738f00207eee974a23360e0c09f8625f (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Angola]] leaves [[OPEC]] over a dispute on [[crude oil]] production quotas. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-67793369 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Prague shooting]]
**Fifteen people are killed and 24 others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at [[Charles University]] in [[Prague]], [[Czech Republic]]. The perpetrator, a student at the university, kills himself after police arrived. The perpetrator had also killed his father prior to the shooting and is also suspected of killing a man and his daughter on December 15. [https://apnews.com/article/prague-shooting-dead-injured-9a383bc6919c1b0d929cf06aa4818341 (AP)]
*An unidentified victim of [[Gary Ridgway]], also known as the Green River Killer, is identified by authorities as Lori Anne Razpotnik after 38 years. [https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2023/12/21/us/green-river-killer-victim-lori-anne-razpotnik/index.html (CNN)]
*In [[Pakistan]], police assault and arrest several protestors during a march from [[Turbat]] to [[Islamabad]], where around 200 people planned to rally to draw attention to the killing of a man in [[Balochistan Police|police]] custody in [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]] in November. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-police-arrest-baluchistan-activists-islamabad-9279b9e5eeb6a35384f7424faebf961d (AP)]
*The [[National Telecommunications Commission]] of the [[Philippines]] announces a 30-day suspension of the broadcast operations of [[Sonshine Media Network International]] following allegations of franchise violations. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-12-21/philippines-suspends-duterte-supporter-s-media-company (Bloomberg)] [https://www.cnnphilippines.com/news/2023/12/21/NTC-suspends-SMNI-operations-for-30-days.html (CNN Philippines)]
*A [[Regional Trial Court|trial court]] in [[Butuan]], Philippines publicizes the conviction of three [[Kapa-Community Ministry International|KAPA]] personnel, including its founder, of syndicated [[fraud]] for being the masterminds in the country's largest [[investment scam|illegal investment scheme]]. [https://www.cnnphilippines.com/news/2023/12/21/KAPA-masterminds-sentenced-to-life-in-prison.html (CNN Philippines)]

'''Science and technology'''
*A [[Stanford]] Internet Observatory investigation finds more than 3,200 images of suspected [[child sexual abuse]] in the AI database [[LAION]], an index used to train AI image-makers such as [[Stable Diffusion]]. In response, LAION temporarily removes its datasets. [https://apnews.com/article/generative-ai-illegal-images-child-abuse-3081a81fa79e2a39b67c11201cfd085f (AP)] 
*The [[International Trade Commission]] rejects Apple’s appeal to a order blocking the company from using technology underlying the Blood oxygen measurement feature on its [[smart watches]]. In response, Apple suspends sales of the products. [https://apnews.com/article/apples-watch-holiday-sales-suspension-patent-dispute-ac77c3bec3e683021b6dd525ef36cd29 (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*The [[European Court of Justice]] rules that threats by [[FIFA]] and [[UEFA]] to sanction [[football clubs]] that wish to join the [[European Super League]] are unlawful.
